desc: Howard and Bernadette kiss each other at their wedding on the roof with Amy, Sheldon, Penny, Leonard and Raj clapping behind them.
Howard sits with two other astronauts, all three of them strapped in and wearing full spacesuits with helmets.
Leonard turns to a comic display and raises both his index fingers above his head.
A wide shot of the space station with swirling clouds around it.
Howard talks to his mom while floating in space.
Howard, in a green polo shirt and cap, pushes off from one wall to the opposite one, as he floats through the space station.
Penny applies white cream with a spatula on Amy's face between her lip and her nose.
Penny closes the lid of some cream container tightly, while sitting next to Amy, who has a white mustache.
Penny wipes off the cream from the spatula with tissue.
Penny sits down on the couch holding a glass of wine, next to Amy, who has a white mustache.
Raj lifts up his foot above the table at the canteen, to show Sheldon and Leonard that he's wearing sandals.
Howard floats through the air in the International Space Station and waves at the laptop with a headset on it.
Howard releases a pen into outer space and it floats.
Bernadette adjusts her glasses when she's talking to Howard online.
A man floats across the International Space Station behind Howard at the laptop.
Sheldon, in a dark grey blazer, and Amy enter the restaurant dining area.
Raj, sitting at the restaurant table, waves at Amy and Sheldon as they come into the restaurant.
Sheldon winks at Amy and makes the "finger guns" gesture, at the restaurant.
Raj gets up and pulls out the chair for Amy as Sheldon sits at the restaurant table.
Amy angrily closes the restaurant menu while sitting at the table.
Raj turns to the waiter and gestures with his hand then holds three fingers up, while sitting at the table with Amy and Sheldon.
Leonard puts down a bowl on the living room table, covered with a red checkered tablecloth, with drinks and plates already on it.
Leonard, in a green shirt, hands Penny a beer from the coffee table covered with a red checkered tablecloth.
Leonard, in green shirt, and Penny, each holding a beer, sit on the sofa.
Leonard taps Penny on the arm and then sits up, puts his beer on the table covered with a red checkered tablecloth.
Leonard stands up and holds up his green shirt to show something written on his belly.
Howard is in zero gravity, next to a computer console when someone's head show up from above.
Howard closes his eyes, then looks down while putting his hand on the spaceship console.
A wide shot of the International Space Station orbiting above the curve of the Earth.
Raj waves his left hand in the air while holding a beer bottle at the other, sitting on the couch in between Howard and Penny.
Penny takes a sip of beer and then shakes the bottle while sitting on the couch with Raj and Leonard, in green shirt.
Raj sits up and puts his beer bottle down on the coffee table covered with a red checkered tablecloth.
Raj, in an orange jacket, gets thrown out of the apartment and puts his hands in his pockets.
Sheldon reaches for his wallet in his jacket pocket while sitting at the restaurant with Amy.
Raj walks into the closed  comic book store while Stuart is folding a t-shirt.
Stuart holds up a Chewbacca mug above the cash register.
Raj places the cup he was holding on the counter.
Howard does a two-finger salute and a wink at the spaceship.
